brief: Answers whether a value can be a given kind, by checking it against every constraint declared for the kind.
detail: CanQ(42).BeA("score") is 1 when 42 satisfies all the constraints of score. The verdict is certain, since a check is deterministic, it joins the session's ask-record, and Why() says which constraint failed. A kind with no declared constraint answers 0 and says nothing is known about it.
